messages:
Nadia: Heads-up  targeting Thu 10:00 PT publish for the launch post. Need owners for: final hero line, benchmark stat + 1-line method blurb, production screenshot, top-banner webinar signup (email prefill), HubSpot hidden fields + UTMs, and a legal quick-pass. Who can take what? :sparkles:

Owen: Ill draft the hero and the bench copy. Will push two distinct hero directions by noon.

Rita: Ill grab a screenshot from staging and export hero/social crops (1200x630 + @2x). Which URL should I use?

Nadia: Use staging: app.redwood.staging/demo?mode=publish. Please scrub any real org names and include token meter + latency panel.

Priya: Ill build the HubSpot form and add hidden fields: lead_source=blog_launch_2026, product_interest=inference, orig_utm, company_size. Will support `email` prefill via query param. Also set up UTMs for A/B: utm_content=hero_x|hero_y.

CreativeBot: Uploaded hero comps: https://drive.redwood/creative/launch_3472229991_v1.png. Recommend social crop 1200x628.

Sam (Legal): Quick guidance on claims: avoid absolutes. Suggest wording: "Internal tests show up to a 58% reduction in per-token inference cost on representative workloads (see method)." Keep method short and high-level; no internal config details. Avoid "enterprise-grade."

Owen: Noted Sam. Draft bench line: "Internal tests show up to a 58% reduction in per-token inference cost on representative workloads (8k request sample; baseline: 4xH100; end-to-end cost measured)." Pushed copy to /content/drafts/launch_post_3472229991.md.

Rita: Captured screenshot from the staging route, scrubbed, exported PNG + webp. Uploaded to the creative drive. :white_check_mark:

Priya: Form created and hidden fields added. Prefill tested via `?email=` and UTMs wired: `?utm_source=redwood&utm_medium=blog&utm_campaign=launch_q4&utm_content={cta_variant}`. Ill add hidden field `lead_tier` for routing: company_size>=500 -> Enterprise AE.

Nadia: For hero variants, Owen what are the two options?

Owen: Option A: "Make inference frictionless for your product."
Option B: "Predictable inference economics for production LLMs."
Want A for organic, B for paid.

Nadia: Good split. Priya  can you add utm_content values `hero_a` and `hero_b` so we can track CTR per creative?

Priya: Yep will set utm_content=hero_a / hero_b and create two CTAs in the CMS. Also adding hidden field `utm_full` to capture full query for debugging.

Sam (Legal): Quick review incoming; ensure the bench method stays high-level and we don't call out batch sizes or internal flags. If copy keeps that constraint I can sign off quickly.

Owen: I removed technical batch details and kept only sample size + baseline hardware. Updated draft.

Nadia: Final checklist  please react with :white_check_mark: when done: hero locked, bench method included, screenshot uploaded, assets optimized, HubSpot form + hidden fields in place, UTMs set, legal sign-off.

Owen: Hero + bench updated and pushed. :white_check_mark:

Rita: Screenshot uploaded and exported. :white_check_mark:

CreativeBot: Assets optimized and social crop generated. :white_check_mark:

Priya: HubSpot form + hidden fields + UTMs + prefill tested; SFDC routing doc updated. :white_check_mark:

Sam (Legal): Approved the updated language. :white_check_mark:

Nadia: Great  scheduling Thu 10:00 PT and adding a top-banner webinar slot (Tue 11am PT) that pre-fills email. Thanks everyone! :tada:
